content: We need to list elements that can be definitively identified based on isotope distribution patterns visible in the mass spectrum. We need the mass spectrum data. Use mass_spectrometry_spectra tool. Then analyze isotopic patterns to identify elements like Cl (35/37 pattern), Br (79/81), S (32/33/34), etc. Also C has M+1 pattern (13C). But definitive identification may require distinct isotopic signatures. Let's get spectrum.
